en:
Alright, looks like everyone's here.
Let's get started.
Oh, what about Kokichi?

Forget about him!
It's his fault for messing around like that!

I guess...he must be a real pro at
hide-and-seek.

I magically looked all over the school,
but he was nowhere to be found.
M-Magically?
No one can find him, huh?

He might've used the <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive's card key<CLT=cltNORMAL>
to enter a place we're unaware of.

Do you think that's where the real <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive<CLT=cltNORMAL>
is being kept? Either way, it's worrisome.

Heh, next time I see him, I just gotta
catch him and ask.
Anyway, let's try out this <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

But...I'm still uneasy about these <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback 
Lights<CLT=cltNORMAL>... Are they really okay to use?

Well, if we don't use them, our memories
will never come back, y'know?

So we've got no choice but to use it! The 
memory we'll get from this is our only clue!
I agree with fish dicks over here!
Who are you calling a chunk of breaded fish!?

Ah-haha, for someone who looks like canned
tuna, you make some pretty good comebacks.
Who are you calling a wad of shredded fish!?
Wait...Kokichi!?

I knew you'd find us here...but only because
it's you.

Thanks for the compliment! So, why are all
my merry friends gathered here?

First things first...
What did you do with that <CLT=cltSTRONG>card key<CLT=cltNORMAL>?

Ooh, so you're worried about that.
Well, relax.
Unfortunately, I couldn't use the card key.
You couldn't use it?

Yeah, I had no idea where to use it, so
I just gave up instead.

You don't seem too disappointed about
not being able to use it.

I *am* disappointed, dammit!
I wanted to use the card key!
I smell another fuckin' lie!
Whatever... Talking to him's a waste of time.
We've got more important things to do.

Oh hey, the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
Lemme see that.

Kaito doesn't have the balls to turn on
the switch—
Of course I do!!!

<CLT=cltMIND>Egged on by Kokichi, Kaito
thumbed the switch hard.

<CLT=cltMIND>And once again,
the world warped—

<CLT=cltMIND>The scenes that flew by inside
my consciousness...
<CLT=cltMIND>And what it all means...
<CLT=cltMIND>All at once, I...
<CLT=cltMIND>I remembered.
Ah! The meteorites!
What happened with the meteorites!?

I remember...TV news and the Internet
talkin' non-stop about those meteorites!

There was a bunch of damage where I lived...
People said it was only a matter of time...

A researcher said that, too. Similar meteorite
impacts happened millions of years ago...

All living organisms on Earth were
annihilated...

There were also a bunch of weird groups 
that started to show up in the streets.

As the meteorites got worse, more people 
started saying it was the end of the world...

Gonta hear that, too! Unless someone
does something, world will end!

Th-Those people were...always handing 
out flyers on street corners...

I saw flyers all over the city, too.
They said, "<CLT=cltSTRONG>Mankind deserves damnation<CLT=cltNORMAL>."
<CLT=cltMIND>Mankind deserves damnation...

<CLT=cltMIND>I remember seeing those
posters, but...

And...the meteorites! What ended up 
happening with the meteorites!?

We haven't seen any since we got here.
Maybe they died down...

Then what happened to that plan? The one 
to save the world from the meteorites?
Oh right...I just remembered that...
It was called the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Gofer Project<CLT=cltNORMAL>, right?

It was the plan that all the countries of the
world came up with to save humanity...

I remember that, too...
But the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Gofer Project<CLT=cltNORMAL>...
Didn't it fail?
Huh? Is that true?

That's what I heard too, but I can't
remember why.

S-So...we can't remember anything 
past that again.

I can't either...
I don't remember anything about the Gofer—

Heh...hehehehe...
Mankind deserves damnation...
Miu...?

Heh...hehehehe...
Mankind deserves damnation... Fuck that!
We're already damned here!

Being stuck here with you losers is the
worst hell there is!
The "you losers" part...wasn't necessary.

Sh-Shut up! I'm tired of this!
Let us outta here! Let us out!

C'mon, don't leave us in here!
Pull us out!
She seems really upset!

Miu, calm down! It's okay!
Gonta will protect you!

<CLT=cltMIND>In the end, the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltMIND> didn't help.
It didn't connect to the other memories.

<CLT=cltMIND>The <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Hunt<CLT=cltMIND> that was
after us...
<CLT=cltMIND>The joint funeral...

<CLT=cltMIND>The meteorites, the cult organization,
the Gofer Project...

<CLT=cltMIND>How are they all connected...?
How do they relate to the Ultimate Academy...?

<CLT=cltMIND>And what happened with all those
meteorites? Did they just stop?

It'll be okay, Shuichi.
Just a little more...
Huh?
We probably need one more...

Everything will start to connect after we
remember one more thing...

<CLT=cltMIND>One more thing?
What is Kokichi—

But I don't think I'd be surprised by the
outcome of this situation.

Like...if we were actually all dead,
and this was the afterlife.
The afterlife?

Wh-Why you... 
Quit saying stupid crap like that!

It's not stupid. If meteorites can happen,
then anything else can happen, too.

C'mon, you're an astronaut, aren't ya? Space
is full of mysteries that we can't even fathom.

That's why, if the meteorites really did fall on
us, anything could've happened.

A mysterious virus could've spread, or some
weird technology...

Or even an <CLT=cltSTRONG>unknown substance<CLT=cltNORMAL> brought to Earth
that could've bent time and space—

That's like science fiction!
I thought our theme was magic!
That's just your theme, Himiko...

Tch, that's just stupid! It's like the setting 
for some third-rate anime or game!
Do you think I'm making this up?

But then how would you explain the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback
Lights<CLT=cltNORMAL>, Exisals, and even Monokuma?

We may be used to it *now*, but that kind of
stuff goes against common sense, y'know?

Which means...it wouldn't be too farfetched if
any of the things I mentioned actually happened.

Shut up! First off, I'm the only one here
who gets to talk about space!
Oh, you're right. Sorry, my bad.

Ughhhh... Wh-Whatever... Just hurry up
so I can get out of here...

S-Stop... You shouldn't think like that...
About getting out of here...

Everyone seems...very tired. We should
probably disperse for the time being.

Oh! You've finally learned to read the air!
Nice job, robot!
I'm...learning every day.

Oh, before we go, Gonta put manhole cover
back how it was.

If we wanna challenge underground again,
this time Gonta definitely—

Ah-haha, no one's dumb enough to challenge
that dump again!
Don't look down on hard work!
Himiko, you've really changed...

...Is what I'd like to say, but working hard 
at escaping from there is pointless.

Well...no matter how much you've changed,
of course you'd think that...

<CLT=cltMIND>We can't keep going like this...
We need to find a way out.

<CLT=cltMIND>I need to solve all of
these mysteries.

<CLT=cltMIND>After our conversation,
we returned to our rooms.
